title: 応用化学専門実験・演習A(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Analytical chemistry/ physical chemistry experiments 2.Organic chemistry experiments 3.Environmental chemistry experiments 4.Data analysis
educationalGoal: You will learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation. You will also acquire the ability to evaluate the results from qualitative and quantitative experiments, and perform logical thinking. Through experiments and exercises, you will learn experimental theories and methods.
advice: Conduct experiments and exercises in analytical chemistry/physical chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry. If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before the next class through research, questions, or other methods. Common to all experiments: Experimental guidance, safety training, examination Analytical chemistry/physical chemistry experiments: Chelatometric titration, chemical kinetics, electrochemistry Organic chemistry experiments: Advanced skills for organic synthesis, extraction of caffeine, synthesis of acetylsalicylic acid, synthesis of azo dyes, preparation and characterization of conducting polymers (or polymethylmethacrylate) Environmental chemistry experiments: Basis of environmental chemistry experiments, BOD measurement, standardization of KMnO4 for measurement of COD, measurement of COD, determination of the composition of a metal complex
books: Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Senmon Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing) Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Jikken Deta wo Tadashiku Atsukau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Zoku Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental knowledge about analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry. If progress of the experiment is delayed, time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the class on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Handle instruments and equipment safely and explain the experimental procedures.
Read the instructions using technical terms and conduct the experiments yourself.
Understand the theoretical basis of the experiments and logically examine experimental results.
Prepare a report from the experiments.
Understand basic experimental procedures and perform specific experiments.

achievementLevels.ideal: By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following: - Use experimental instruments safely and accurately. - Understand and use the analytical apparatus. - Devise a personal experimental plan according to the experimental instructions and conduct the experiments. - Prepare a report logically and hand in by the deadline.
achievementLevels.standard: By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following: - Use experimental instruments safely. - Use the analytical apparatus. - Conduct the experiments according to the experimental instructions. - Prepare a report and hand in by the deadline.

lessons.content: Safety training and guidance for analytical chemistry/physical chemistry experiments -Volumetric analysis by chelatometric titration (1) -Preparation and standardization of EDTA-2Na solution
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Describe the representative structures of metal chelates. Explain the mechanism of chelatometric titration. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Volumetric analysis by chelatometric titration (2) -Analysis of Ca2+ and Mg2+ contents in water
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Describe the formation constants of metal chelates and hydroxides. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Chemical kinetics -Decomposition kinetics of hydrogen peroxide
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Describe reaction order and rate constants. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
Pre-Lab Assignment: Describe the Faraday constant and determine isotope abundance of copper. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Examination in analytical chemistry/physical chemistry experiments Self-evaluation
Safety training and instruction for organic chemistry experiments -Extraction of caffeine
lessons.assignments: Readings: Section Organic Chemistry, Chapter 0 "Safety Rules" Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare an experimental workflow for extraction from natural sources. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare an experimental workflow for synthesis #1 Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare an experimental workflow for synthesis #2 Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Preparation and characterization of polyaniline (or polymethylmethacrylate)
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare an experimental workflow for synthesis #3 Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Examination for organic chemistry experiments Self-evaluation
lessons.assignments: Assignment: Complete protocols for extraction of caffeine and synthesis #1 through #3. Study for examination.

lessons.content: Safety training and instruction for environmental chemistry experiments Measurement of BOD (biochemical oxygen demand)
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Read the experimental instructions and prepare a preliminary report on the basic theory of BOD test. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Standardization of KMnO4 for measurement of COD
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Read the experimental instructions and prepare a preliminary report on standard ization of KMnO4. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
Pre-Lab Assignment: Read the experimental instructions and prepare a preliminary report on the COD test. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Determination of the composition of a metal complex
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Read the experimental instructions and prepare a preliminary report on the determination of metal complex composition. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
